```plato
// ISurface response properties of a body. StaticFriction and DynamicFriction
// are dimensionless Coulomb coefficients; Restitution is the bounciness in
// [0, 1]; the combine kinds say how the two touching materials' values merge.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Friction)
type PhysicsMaterial
    implements IValue
{
    StaticFriction: Number;
    DynamicFriction: Number;
    Restitution: Proportion;
    FrictionCombine: MaterialCombine;
    RestitutionCombine: MaterialCombine;
}
```
